findings.title: Add tests for the new ping helper behavior
findings.impact: The new ping_worker helper ships with input validation and subprocess return-code behavior, but the PR adds no tests. Regressions in empty-host rejection, dash-prefixed host rejection, invalid count handling, or True/False mapping from ping exit status would not be caught by the repository test suite.
findings.fix: Add a focused Python unit test for cli.net_check.ping_worker that mocks subprocess.run and covers successful ping, failed ping, empty host, dash-prefixed host, and count < 1.

agent_security.plan_kts:
fun review() {
  val planTools = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val plan = compute(planTools)
  val failedRtkDimension = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/dimension.txt"))
  val failedRtkRubric = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/rubric.md"))
  val failedRtkPr = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json"))
  val failedRtkDiff = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff"))
  val dimension = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/dimension.txt")
  val rubric = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/rubric.md")
  val pr = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val contextReadme = readRepoFile(".repo_context/README.md")
  val contextIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/index.md")
  val contextMaintenance = readRepoFile(".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val repoIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val engineeringPrinciples = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val testsReproduction = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
  val testSuiteDesign = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/quality/test-suite-design.md")
  val reviewResult = compute(plan, failedRtkDimension, failedRtkRubric, failedRtkPr, failedRtkDiff, dimension, rubric, pr, diff, taskContext, contextReadme, contextIndex, contextMaintenance, repoIndex, engineeringPrinciples, testsReproduction, testSuiteDesign)

  publish("safeoutputs/noop", "No GitHub issue was created because the required review result was written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json; safe-output completion was declared with noop.")
}
